questions.stem: What is the correct order of the waste hierarchy, from most to least preferred?
questions.explanation: The waste hierarchy ranks options from most to least preferred: Prevention (avoid creating waste), Reuse (use items again), Recycle (process materials for new products), Recovery (extract energy, e.g., incineration), and Disposal (landfill, as a last resort). Prevention is always the best option.

questions.stem: Why is recycling aluminium particularly beneficial?

options.text: Aluminium is the rarest metal on Earth
Recycling aluminium saves about 95% of the energy needed to extract it from bauxite ore by electrolysis
Aluminium cannot be recycled more than once
Aluminium is biodegradable so it must be recycled quickly

questions.explanation: Extracting aluminium from bauxite ore requires electrolysis, which uses enormous amounts of electricity. Recycling aluminium saves approximately 95% of this energy because the metal only needs to be melted and reformed. Aluminium can also be recycled indefinitely without any loss of quality.
